Subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the thoughtful discussion about FintechCo's inference needs. Quick recap from my side: during the call you mentioned a target of roughly 300 req/min (peak bursts up to ~600/min), 95th pct latency target under 200ms for chat completions, and typical prompt+response sizes in the 1.5k–2.5k token range. You also noted that the integration will initially use a smaller model family for routing but you'd like a path for higher-throughput models as usage grows.

Next step: our solutions team (Marissa) will run a dedicated capacity sizing session to translate those numbers into GPU pool sizing, recommended batching/kv-cache configuration, and a rollout plan (canary + fallback). Could we schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive that includes your infra lead and the engineer who owns latency SLOs? Proposed slots next week (PT):

- Tue 2027-06-16 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed 2027-06-17 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Wed 2027-06-17 1:00–2:00 PM PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple times that do and I’ll get it on the calendar. I’ll attach our capacity sizing template ahead of time so your team can paste key traffic profiles and token distributions — will make the meeting much more productive.

Thanks,
David
